utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Uli — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I could use help sorting donations and carrying the heavier boxes if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can sort donations and help carry the heavier boxes. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and how we’ll coordinate everything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm you’re actually in for the repair drive? I just want to make sure we’re on the same page about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’m in — I just need us to lock down the timing and a simple plan so I can coordinate it properly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I can still help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah—just bring any tools you’re comfortable with, and we’ll sort the rest out together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I’ll grab a few tools and head over. Just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll do that — I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the repair drive plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — we’ve got a solid pile of donations started, and I can sort tools again if you want. We’re still looking for a few more screwdrivers and a drill.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I can swing by and bring a screwdriver if you still need one. What kind of drill are you hoping for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what time is the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 AM, and if you can bring a drill, some screwdrivers, and a few work gloves, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, and gloves, and I’ll be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we decide what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we said 9 a.m., but I can double-check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please double-check—I want to make sure I’ve got the right time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a great chance to pull everyone together. I can help spread the word and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, Jules. I’ll keep a list of who needs what and where they’re located so we can match people up quickly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll start checking in with folks I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by making a list of the needed repairs and who’s available to help? I’ll coordinate the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll put together the repair list and check who’s available to help, then I’ll send it over to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we still have for the repair drive and make a quick list. Just tell me what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’d help — just send me the quick list of what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the bins and jot down what’s missing, then send you the quick list. If you already know any must-haves, tell me and I’ll look for those first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard a few folks are already signing up for the repair drive—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I might stop by and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great—there’s always plenty to do, even if it’s just sorting supplies or greeting people.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening—what details do you have about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re aiming for this Saturday after school drop-off, and I can send over the list of items we still need. If that works, I’ll also coordinate who can help sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good—please send the item list, and I’ll check what I can help with after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the time and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll text you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep everyone updated and make it easy for folks to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block so nobody misses it. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the details—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just tools and a hand sorting donations. If you can come by later, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can swing by later and help sort donations. Just remind me what time, since I might forget.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We still need to tighten a few loose handrails, patch that back fence, and check the donated bikes. I’ve got some tools if you want to grab them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can grab the tools and start with the handrails if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized, Opal—just tell me what needs attention first and I’ll put it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—let’s start with the front gate latch and the porch light by the steps. Those are the spots I’d flag first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it—I’ll put the gate latch and porch light at the top of the list and keep things moving from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the route, timing, and what we’re hauling first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the route, timing, and load details right away, and I’d love to have you with us.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once I see those details, I can confirm whether I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—I’d want to check the latest details before I say that for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I’d rather not assume—can you confirm it once you’ve checked?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what time are we meeting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by a little late—how about 6:30? Just bring a flashlight and whatever tools you’ve got handy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me. I’ll bring a flashlight and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s coming along, but we’re still short on a few supplies. I’m keeping a running list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — if you send me the list, I can keep an ear out for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my toolkit by, but I’d forgotten. If you still need a hand, I can come over and help out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Oren — come by whenever you can, and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’m on my way now — sorry again for the delay. I’ll grab my toolkit and head over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—just tell me what the repair drive needs and when.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. We need volunteers for sorting, pickup runs, and a few tools—I'll send the time slots and list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—send it over, and I’ll see where I can fit in around school drop-off and pickup.
